name: Erin Maye Quade
stance: Authored the first state ban on AI nudification tools and a proposed ban on AI companions for minors.

statements.text: Carried HF 1606, banning AI nudification technology, which passed the Senate 65-0.
Introduced a bill to bar companies from letting people under 18 use AI companion chatbots.
